extraction.Name: Samuel Miller
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent was recorded March 21, 1918 but the records do not show by whom.
extraction.Buyer: The land was mortgaged April 12, 1918 for $3,000 and again August 23, 1918 for $1,500. On August 23, 1918 by deed signed by Samuel Miller the land was conveyed to Mary Miller for $1.00, love and affection, subject to the mortgages shown above.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612825 issued; southwest quarter of section 29, township 96, range 70; receipt for patent signed February 11, 1918.
